Belarusian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from English sport.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [sport]
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

спорт • (sport) m inan (genitive спо́рту, nominative plural спо́рты, genitive plural спо́ртаў, relational adjective спарты́ўны or спарто́вы)

  1. sport

[edit]

Bulgarian

[edit]
Bulgarian Wikipedia has an article on:
спорт
Wikipedia bg

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from English sport.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [spɔrt]
  • Audio (Standard Bulgarian):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ɔrt

Noun

[edit]

спорт • (sport) m (relational adjective спо́ртен)

  1. sport (any activity that uses physical exertion or skills competitively under a set of rules that is not based on aesthetics)

Pannonian Rusyn

  • Rhymes: -ɔrt

Noun

спорт (sport) m inan (relational adjective спортски)
